skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize the historical context of the emergence, development, and succession of economic theories.
Understand the inheritance and differences in content and methodology among various schools of economic thought throughout history.
Evaluate the achievements and limitations of economic theories, deriving theoretical and practical significance.
Apply knowledge of economic theories to operate effectively in a market economy, maximizing profits.
Analyze policies for economic research and strategy development suitable for different stages of historical development.
Develop logical economic thinking, enhancing research quality and problem-solving skills in practical activities after graduation.
Demonstrate ability to independently learn and understand materials to complete assigned tasks.
Participate in group work and presentations, contributing to team projects.
